offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); 每超过10个结果之一加 $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（URL、页面内容、Highlights、Structured outputs、AI summary）
offerings.note: 搜索类型 fast(450ms)/auto(~1s)/deep(4-12s)；每个请求最多10个结果外包计价；吃支持最多1,000结果企业版

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite $12 / 1k requests; deep $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning $15 / 1k requests
offerings.price_basis: PAYG base price (up to 10 results)，price 为 deep/deep-lite 档
offerings.output_type: 多步研究，结构化输出与引用
offerings.note: deep-lite ~4s; deep 4–15s; deep-reasoning 12–40s; 额外结果与AI摘要费用同标准搜索

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per page, per content type
offerings.output_type: Full page text, highlights, and summaries for known URLs
offerings.note: 一个页面的 text+highlights 算作两个内容类型，分别计费

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: LLM answer to a question, with citations

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests; 每超过10个结果之一加 $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web
